claims.text: The hyperparameters explored include vector dimension size, type of algorithm, learning rate, training epochs, window size, and vocabulary size.
Various combinations of hyperparameters were tested, including dimensions ranging from 50 to 1,000 and vocabulary sizes from 30,000 to 3,000,000.
The study aims to find optimal combinations of hyperparameters for word2vec in NLP tasks.
